LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticCarapace.label: Symbiotic Carapace
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticCarapace.description: A living armor shell that slowly repairs ordinary wounds while worn. Regeneration consumes the wearer's metabolism: hunger rises 50% faster, and each repair adds symbiotic strain. It pauses while the wearer is hungry.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilArmor.label: Phaseveil Armor
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilArmor.description: A light phase-distortion suit. Select its wearer and activate Phaseveil to become invisible for up to 20 seconds; the ability has a 90-second cooldown. Attacking or being downed ends the effect. Active cloaking builds neural fatigue, which recovers faster during rest.
